faq.q: How do I place an order?
faq.a: Add items to the cart, enter your contact details and how you want to receive the order. A manager will call to confirm it.
For now you can pay on delivery in cash or by card. Online payment will be added later.

faq.q: What if the item doesn't suit me?
faq.a: Return terms are on the Returns page. Keep the receipt and packaging.
Cities and delivery times are listed on the Delivery page.

delivery.title: Delivery
body: We deliver orders by courier and offer pickup.
Cities, delivery times and costs will be published once the terms are approved.
A manager confirms the delivery date by phone after you place the order.

payment.title: Payment
body: Right now you can pay on delivery, in cash or by bank card.
The price is fixed when the manager confirms the order.
Online payment will be added after the payment provider is reviewed.

warranty.title: Warranty
body: Every product has a warranty; the term is shown on the product page.
Keep the receipt and warranty card for warranty claims.
Service center addresses will be published once approved.

returns.title: Returns and exchange
body: Products can be returned or exchanged under the laws of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
The product must keep its condition, packaging and accessories.
The exact return procedure and terms will be published once approved.

contacts.title: Contacts
body: Phone, address and opening hours will appear once the store owner approves them.
For now, a manager will contact you about your order using the phone you provide.

privacy.title: Privacy
body: We use your name, phone and address only to process and deliver your order.
We do not store bank card details.
The full privacy policy will be published after legal review.
